mentions.name: Stowly
mentions.description: A home inventory management app for recording everything you own, from appliances to cars, and tracking warranties, return periods, receipts, maintenance tasks with due-date reminders, and service history. It offers insurance exports and read-only share links so an insurance adjuster can see all items lost in an event, plus family sharing under a single upgraded account, templates, tags, and a free tier for unlimited items with paid upgrades for more capabilities.
mentions.problem: Keeping track of everything you own — warranties, return periods, receipts, and maintenance tasks — is scattered and hard to manage, and filing an insurance claim requires complete documentation of the items lost.
mentions.audience: Homeowners and families managing household possessions, including people who need to document lost items for insurance claims
mentions.source_excerpt:
Been working on a couple of things -- Stowly (https://getstowly.app) and Recoup (not yet public).

Stowly is a home inventory management app where you can record all of the things you own (from appliances to cars and more), track warranties, return periods, receipts, maintenance tasks you need to complete, service history and more.  One of the big hits so far has been the insurance export and read-only share links.
mentions.author: dotfrag

mentions.name: Stowly
mentions.description: This home inventory app lets users keep track of all their possessions, maintenance tasks, service history, and receipts. It monitors warranty information and alerts users when warranties are coming up, manages recurring maintenance tasks like changing the air filter, and logs service and repair history (e.g., a fixed oven). For disaster situations, it can export a report for insurance or generate a read-only share link to show an adjustor all lost items and their values.
mentions.problem: People struggle to track their belongings, warranty information, and recurring home maintenance, and after a disaster they lack organized documentation of lost items and their values for insurance claims.
mentions.source_excerpt: Stowly - https://getstowly.app - a home inventory app to keep track of all your things, maintenance tasks, service history, receipts, etc. Helps keep track of warranty information and alert you when it's coming up.
mentions.author: dotfrag
